canonicalDescription: Page-aware MCP server for deterministic website image analysis and safe image optimization with bounded no-regression guards and SSRF-protected URL ingestion.
canonicalCapabilities: optimize one caller-provided image with bounded format and resize policy
generate responsive image variants without upscaling
compare original and candidate image versions
optimize a bounded batch of preselected safe image items
analyze a bounded set of images discovered from a public HTTP(S) page in static HTML fast mode
recompress a bounded set of URL-discovered images at original dimensions and expose accepted outputs as temporary MCP resources
safetyFacts: network access exists only in the two URL tools and passes through the dedicated SSRF-protected fetch boundary
URL mode blocks unsafe schemes, URL credentials, localhost/private/link-local/reserved addresses and redirects to prohibited targets
URL mode caps page bytes, per-image bytes, accepted total image bytes, redirects, timeouts, image count and concurrency
URL mode does not claim browser-rendered dimensions, currentSrc, LCP, CSS background discovery or JavaScript-driven lazy content
accepted binaries are stored only in an isolated temporary artifact store and exposed through resource_link plus resources/read
batch input is bounded to 20 items
responsive variant generation is bounded to 6 widths
image core enforces no-upscale and never-increase-bytes guards
current MCP package does not write changes to production

channels.proof: registry API returns exact server name and version

requires: public GitHub server repository or public hosted connector
channels.proof: listing is discoverable, ownership claimed, health/quality score present

requires: Streamable HTTP public URL or MCPB bundle
channels.proof: server page is discoverable and install/try flow works
searchable mcp.so listing with correct install/source data
